bull.t: Recurring ARR Growth And Customer Expansion
bull.b: Strong subscription ARR growth and retention indicate durable customer demand for Rubrik’s platform. Net expansion above 119% and increasing large-customer adoption support recurring revenue visibility, deeper account penetration, and continued scale across enterprise and government markets.

High gross margins combined with positive operating and free cash flow show improving software economics and meaningful cash conversion. This provides resources for research, product development, and go-to-market investment while reducing reliance on external funding to support growth.

bull.t: Raised Outlook And Broad Product Momentum
bull.b: Higher full-year guidance signals management sees continued execution across subscription growth, margins, earnings, and cash generation. Momentum in identity resilience, Rubrik Agent Cloud, and cyber-recovery products can broaden the platform and strengthen its strategic relevance over coming quarters.

bear.t: Leveraged Balance Sheet With Negative Equity
bear.b: The combination of sizable debt and negative equity reduces financial flexibility despite the company’s cash generation. It can constrain capital allocation, complicate assessment of leverage, and leave Rubrik more exposed to refinancing or balance-sheet pressure if operating conditions weaken.

Rubrik has not yet converted its strong revenue growth and gross margins into GAAP profitability. Persistent operating and net losses may limit internally funded expansion, increase dependence on disciplined cost control, and leave earnings more sensitive to investment levels and revenue execution.

bear.t: Uneven Cloud Growth And Early RAC Monetization
bear.b: Cloud growth below overall subscription ARR growth and the limited near-term contribution from Rubrik Agent Cloud create execution uncertainty within important growth initiatives. The company must sustain core demand while converting emerging products and migration opportunities into durable recurring revenue.
